messages:
emily: Quick thread to iterate on postmortem follow-ups. TLDR proposals: (A) enforce single-owner SLA per remediation, (B) 30/60/90 checkpoint windows, (C) new "remediation shepherd" role per sprint, (D) weekly short digest in #incidents. Open to suggestions.

hao: +1. Real problem is ownership drift. Suggestion: when an action is created it must have: owner, due_epoch, severity, blocked_by(optional). If owner is unassigned for 48h auto-assign to oncall lead.

diego: For tracking, let's avoid mixing bug-fix tasks with remediations. Add a "type: remediation" tag so board filters can separate. Also recommend a required "closure_reason" field when closing (fix/deferred/duplicate).

lin: propose 30/60/90 checkpoints are automated: create a reminder note at each checkpoint with snapshot of status + who updated it. That way PMs and eng managers can see progress without digging into the thread.

emily: good. What about rotation? we currently rotate IC every week; should remediation shepherd be overlapping (1-week handoff) or 2-week assigned?

hao: make shepherd 2-week so they can follow through and escalate. IC stays weekly. Shepherd nudges owners and clears minor blockers, escalates bigger ones to oncall lead.

ops-bot: Policy change noted: automation candidate "rem_shepherd" (interval=2w). No rollout until manual opt-in.

diego: dashboards: add recurrence_score = count(type=incident WHERE tag=similar_root IN last_90d). We can surface recurrence_score > 1 as a pulse. Also visual: heatmap by service + recurrence_score.

lin: data model suggestion: store "last_seen_epoch" and "first_seen_epoch" on the remediation to compute windows; recurrence_score calc becomes straightforward.

emily: minimal remediation JSON template (for board card description):
```
action: short summary
owner: @username
due_epoch: 1670000000
severity: P1/P2
type: remediation
blocked_by: ticket# or "none"
closure_reason: ""
recurrence_tag: infra|config|process|3rd_party
last_update_epoch: 1670001000
```

hao: love this. Also add an optional "followup_checkpoints" field that auto-populates with timestamps for 30/60/90 on creation so we can track who updated during each window.

diego: comms cadence: weekly digest to #incidents on Monday 09:00 with 3 bullets: top 3 overdue remediations, new recurring patterns, closed since last digest. Include a link to the remediation board and a 1-line ask for execs when needed. Keep it human-readable.

emily: rollout plan idea: pilot for 6 weeks on two services (auth + kv-store). Pri/test: we'll tag existing remediations and backfill fields for the pilot. At end of pilot collect metrics: avg_time_open, percent_closed_by_due, recurrence_trend.

ops-bot: Created pilot checklist: https://redwood/tasks/3301 (pilot board), https://redwood/tasks/3302 (dashboard queries), https://redwood/tasks/3303 (digest template).

h ao: (typo correction) -> hao: I'll own pilot execution and weekly status. Diego will own recurrence queries and Lin will own board template/backfill.

diego: one extra ask: include an automated alert when a remediation is open >21 days AND recurrence_score >=2. That should help triage persistent issues.

emily: agreed. ok next steps summary:
- hao: run pilot & post weekly status in this thread (owner)
- lin: board template + backfill for pilot services by Thu
- diego: recurrence queries + alert rule by Wed
- emily: update oncall playbook with shepherd role + rotation details by next Mon

lin: noted. I'll also add a small "blocked_eta" free-text field for vendor/legal blockers so shepherds can better escalate.

emily: thanks all. We'll review pilot metrics after 6 weeks and decide global rollout. :calendar:
